description: This file contains the implementation of a PSR-7 URI class, including methods for constructing, manipulating, and converting URI components, as well as handling encoding and validation.

classes.name: Nyholm\Psr7\Uri
classes.description: A class implementing the PSR-7 UriInterface, providing URI parsing, building, and string conversion functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a URI object from a URI string, parsing its components.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the URI.

methods.name: getScheme
methods.description: Returns the URI scheme.

methods.name: getAuthority
methods.description: Returns the authority component of the URI, including user info, host, and port.

methods.name: getUserInfo
methods.description: Returns the user info part of the URI.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Returns the host component of the URI.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port number of the URI.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the path component of the URI, ensuring proper formatting.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Returns the query string of the URI.

methods.name: getFragment
methods.description: Returns the fragment component of the URI.

methods.name: withScheme
methods.description: Returns a new URI instance with the specified scheme.

methods.name: withUserInfo
methods.description: Returns a new URI instance with the specified user info and optional password.

methods.name: withHost
methods.description: Returns a new URI instance with the specified host.

methods.name: withPort
methods.description: Returns a new URI instance with the specified port.

methods.name: withPath
methods.description: Returns a new URI instance with the specified path.

methods.name: withQuery
methods.description: Returns a new URI instance with the specified query.

methods.name: withFragment
methods.description: Returns a new URI instance with the specified fragment.

methods.name: createUriString
methods.description: Static method to assemble a URI string from its components.

methods.name: isNonStandardPort
methods.description: Checks if a port is non-standard for the given scheme.

methods.name: filterPort
methods.description: Validates and filters the port value.

methods.name: filterPath
methods.description: Validates and encodes the path component.

methods.name: filterQueryAndFragment
methods.description: Validates and encodes query and fragment components.

methods.name: rawurlencodeMatchZero
methods.description: Helper for encoding regex matches.
